EmailTemplate.description: Email to BPLs about how to recruit Type O donors.
EmailTemplate.name: Evergreen_General_Type O Recruitment
EmailTemplate.subject: O So Needed: Help increase type O donations
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear [BPL Name],
**Add personal introduction**
Thank you for all that you are doing for patients in need! I so appreciate your effects to increase Type O collections.
Did you know that type O blood is most requested by hospitals and is often in short supply? In emergency situations when there’s no time to determine a patient’s blood type or for immune deficient infants, doctors reach for type O blood.
The recruitment actions you take as a Blood Program Leader can directly impact our ability to respond to hospital demand and help ensure patients get the blood they need.
Tips for success at your upcoming blood drive:
Use the attached type O info sheet and donor email template [NOTE: Available on the Type O Field page; ATTACH to email] to recruit eligible type O blood donors.
Before the blood drive, make a personal call to type O donors, reminding them why their appointment is needed and thank them for scheduling an appointment to give blood.
If a Power Red device is assigned to the blood drive, ensure the type O donor is educated on the process and, if eligible, is encouraged to donate Power Red.
Thank you again for your commitment to our lifesaving mission. I am confident that with some additional efforts, you will increase your type O donors. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out – I’m always here to help!
Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Your Email]
